translation: When cold qi lodges, the vessel does not pass; when the vessel does not pass, qi follows it, therefore there is panting and movement responding to the hand. Wang Shuhe's Maijing (Pulse Classic) says: When both hands' pulses, floated, both have yang, and sunk, both have yin, and yin and yang are both abundant, this is the pulse of the Chong and Du vessels. The Chong and Du vessels are the pathways of the twelve channels.
